description: Returns data policies for the projects specified in the request.

parameters.description: A list of project identifiers. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list.
parameters.name: ids

schema.description: A list of up to 50 project identifiers. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list.

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Invalid request: some projects are not available or do not exist."],"errors":{}}

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid or includes invalid or not-permitted project identifiers.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the client is not authorized to make the request.
